title: Emergence of enhancers at late DNA replicating regions.
authors: Cornejo-Paramo, Paola; Petrova, Veronika; Zhang, Xuan; Young, Robert S; Wong, Emily S
one_liner_zh: 该文利用深度学习序列模型分析增强子出现与DNA复制时间的关系，涉及TF结合突变，但核心是基因组进化而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移但深度不足。
abstract: Enhancers are fast-evolving genomic sequences that control spatiotemporal gene expression patterns. By examining enhancer turnover across mammalian species and in multiple tissue types, we uncover a relationship between the emergence of enhancers and genome organization as a function of germline DNA replication time. While enhancers are most abundant in euchromatic regions, enhancers emerge almost twice as often in late compared to early germline replicating regions, independent of transposable elements. Using a deep learning sequence model, we demonstrate that new enhancers are enriched for mutations that alter transcription factor (TF) binding. Recently evolved enhancers appear to be mostly neutrally evolving and enriched in eQTLs. They also show more tissue specificity than conserved enhancers, and the TFs that bind to these elements, as inferred by binding sequences, also show increased tissue-specific gene expression. We find a similar relationship with DNA replication time in cancer, suggesting that these observations may be time-invariant principles of genome evolution. Our work underscores that genome organization has a profound impact in shaping mammalian gene regulation.
abstract_zh: 增强子是快速进化的基因组序列，控制着时空基因表达模式。通过检查哺乳动物物种及多种组织类型中增强子的更替，我们揭示了增强子的出现与基因组组织之间随种系DNA复制时间变化的关系。尽管增强子在常染色质区域最为丰富，但在晚复制种系区域中，增强子的出现频率几乎是早复制区域的两倍，且这一现象与转座子无关。利用深度学习序列模型，我们证明新增强子富集了改变转录因子（TF）结合的突变。近期进化的增强子似乎大多处于中性进化状态，并在表达数量性状位点（eQTLs）中富集。它们还显示出比保守增强子更高的组织特异性，且根据结合序列推断，结合这些元件的转录因子也表现出增强的组织特异性基因表达。我们在癌症中也发现了与DNA复制时间的类似关系，表明这些观察结果可能是基因组进化的时间不变原则。我们的工作强调了基因组组织在塑造哺乳动物基因调控中的深远影响。
